implementation: A single persistent115133 anchor at the water surface owns the run. Rotation lookup AND ResetTime admission controls visibility and cleanup; it stays active after its grid first loads. Four separately recorded115132 summon GUIDs must die; unrelated actors and duplicate callbacks cannot advance it. Failed summons retry without making a three-actor run ready.

Helya is passive/stationary but attackable. Its final scaled damage hook compares GetHealth(attacker) and clamps a lethal hit at1HP, preserving the four-ritualist requirement. Ritualists stay rooted and retain casting presentation rather than chasing. Existing text groups1/2 are used for their attack/death quotes.

Player contribution is recorded on damage, including the first lethal pet hit. Native Unit::Kill still dispatches SummonedCreatureDies when a ritualist AI is unavailable. Nearby party members can share credit; observers, wrong phase, dead/out-of-range players and absent/already-completed WQs are excluded. No faction restriction is added; native factions2817/16/14 pass IsHostileToPlayers. Native IsAllowedInRaid admission also applies before rewarding; a raid-ineligible player cannot repeatedly farm fragments while the core refuses WQ credit.

Native229113 radius41 is150 yards on both effects; completion uses150-yard center distance, excluding the giant model combat radius. After the fourth distinct death, group4 dialogue starts and6000ms elapse before credit. Optional attack/conversation visual failure cannot consume or block this independent timer.
